requirements.text: renameCategory in src/lib/categories.ts must update every saved receipt whose category is the old name (case‑insensitive) to the new name for default categories.
renameCategory in src/lib/categories.ts must update every saved receipt whose category is the old name (case‑insensitive) to the new name for custom categories.
After a successful rename, no receipt uses the old category name.
After a successful rename, getAllCategories no longer lists the old category name.
After a successful rename, syncCategoriesWithReceipts does not re‑introduce the old category name.
After a successful rename, isCategoryInUse(newName) returns true when receipts previously used the old name.
Receipts belonging to other categories remain unchanged after rename.
All other fields of the updated receipts stay exactly as they were after rename.
If renameCategory fails due to invalid name, duplicate name, or category not found, no receipts are modified.

validateMileageMiles accepts any number greater than 0 with up to one decimal place (e.g., 12.5) and rejects 0, negative numbers, numbers with more than one decimal place (e.g., 12.55) and non‑numeric text.
The Miles field on the Add mileage screen accepts the string "12.5" as valid input.
The deduction shown on the Add mileage screen uses the decimal mileage value entered.
The deduction saved to the database uses the decimal mileage value entered.
The Receipt add button never covers the Recent activity list.
The Mileage add button never covers the Recent activity list.
The "Receipt saved" confirmation never covers the Recent activity list.
Every row in the Recent activity list displays its amount.
The Recent activity list can be scrolled past the add buttons.
The bottom tab labels (Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage, Settings) are fully visible on a 390x844 phone screen.
The Add receipt screen title appears only once, in the header.
The date picker icon is positioned inside the Date field.
There are no empty gaps larger than the standard spacing between fields on the Add receipt screen.
The "Scan receipt" button is not shown when scanning is not available.
In Settings, the App lock appears once as a switch row, with no separate App lock button.
In Settings, the entries Tax settings, Categories, Export, Backup & restore, View Terms and Privacy Policy are displayed as list rows with a chevron, not as outlined buttons.
In Settings, the Delete all data entry is shown in the error color.
In Settings, the Delete all data entry appears as the last entry in the list.
In Settings, the Delete all data entry is visually separated from the other entries.
Keep every existing feature, test, and screen working.
